headline: Stocks to watch today: Meesho, Manappuram Finance, EIH, and others
hook: Upcoming trading session focus list announced

modes.bear: Inclusion on morning lists offers no fundamental catalyst and can invite speculative volatility.
modes.bull: Curated watchlists highlight active retail attention and potential volume spikes for listed counters.

summary: Moneycontrol has released its daily curated list of stocks to watch for the upcoming trading session. The watchlist includes prominent names such as Meesho, Manappuram Finance, EIH, TD Power Systems, NMDC Steel, Dilip Buildcon, and Ola. Retail investors often track these morning compilation lists to identify potential intraday or short-term momentum opportunities. whats_next: Market opening bell and subsequent price action for listed stocks.
why_it_matters: Daily stock watchlists highlight active equities for potential short-term trading.

headline: NMDC Steel reports ₹61 crore profit in Q2

modes.bear: Despite the turnaround, the company remains in a cyclical sector where sustained profitability depends heavily on volatile global steel prices.
modes.bull: The company has successfully turned a loss into a profit with double-digit revenue growth and expanding margins, indicating strong operational recovery.
modes.simple: NMDC Steel made a profit this quarter after losing money last year. This means the company is selling more or managing its costs better, which is generally a good sign for the business.

summary: NMDC Steel posted a net profit of ₹61 crore for the second quarter of FY27, reversing a loss of ₹115 crore from the same period last year. The company recorded an 11% increase in revenue alongside an EBITDA of ₹462.2 crore. Operating margins improved to 12.3% during the quarter. This turnaround reflects improved operational efficiency for the steel manufacturer.
why_it_matters: Improved margins signal better operational health for shareholders.

headline: NMDC Steel reports financial results for September 2026 quarter

modes.bear: Quarterly performance metrics may reflect ongoing steel sector cost pressures.
modes.bull: Earnings filing provides transparent insight into operational progress.
modes.simple: NMDC Steel has shared its financial report for the July-September quarter with the stock exchange. Investors can check these results to see how the company is performing.

summary: NMDC Steel Limited has officially submitted its financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, to the stock exchange. The filing provides the company's performance metrics for the period. Retail investors can review these numbers to assess the company's operational progress and profitability. Quarterly earnings filings help stakeholders track fundamental health and revenue trends.
why_it_matters: Quarterly earnings data guides valuation and investment decisions for NMDC Steel shareholders.
